metadata.description: nlyu-pm: a Claude Code plugin that takes a product manager from public evidence to a selected opportunity, a clickable prototype, and an engineering-ready PRD on a real product: your own project or repository (BYOP) or one of five example open-source cases, plus a skill builder for writing your own PM skill.

plugins.name: nlyu-pm
plugins.description: Product discovery to PRD for PMs. /nlyu-pm:scout researches public sources on your own repository (BYOP) or an example open-source product and picks an opportunity, /nlyu-pm:prototype builds a clickable flow, /nlyu-pm:prd writes a repository-grounded PRD with an independent review, /nlyu-pm:create-skill turns one of your practices into a skill.
